home.title: {{config.serviceName}} Home
home.heroBody: This container serves the stateful Playwright REST API, Streamable MCP endpoint, Swagger UI, and a local demo page for offline browser automation. Use the links below to inspect the API surface quickly or drive the built-in test page with screenshot capture.
home.autoLanguageNote: The UI follows the browser language automatically and supports Korean and English.
home.swaggerDescription: Browse the REST and MCP API in an offline-friendly UI.
home.playgroundDescription: Call the service interactively, create sessions, and capture screenshots.
home.demoDescription: Simple local page for stable Playwright automation checks.
home.openApiDescription: Raw OpenAPI document for client generation or import.
home.runsDescription: Runs, per-step timelines, failure causes and evidence.

playground.title: {{config.serviceName}} Playground
playground.heroBody: Use this page to call the built-in REST API against the current container, create a live browser session, navigate to the local demo page, and preview screenshot artifacts without leaving the browser.
playground.quickCallsBody: Basic endpoints for connectivity and script registry checks.
playground.createRunBody: Submit a script execution request using the registered script list from this container.
playground.sessionFlowBody: Create a low-level session, open the local demo page, click and type, then capture a screenshot artifact.
playground.currentStatusBody: The latest API call result and a short human-readable summary are shown here.
playground.screenshotPreviewBody: When a screenshot artifact is created, it is shown below using the API download path.
playground.jsonResultBody: All responses are rendered as pretty JSON so the page is useful for debugging in air-gapped environments.
playground.apiTokenPlaceholder: Only needed when API_TOKEN is set
playground.authRequiredNotice: This server requires an API token. Fill in the API token field above first.

demo.title: Playwright Player Demo Page
demo.heroBody: This local page is designed for stable browser automation in offline environments. Visible copy changes with the browser language, while core controls keep stable test ids.
demo.targetNote: Visible labels can change by locale, but the test ids stay stable.
demo.interactionBody: Use the controls below with the low-level session API.

runs.title: {{config.serviceName}} run history
runs.heroBody: Runs and their per-step timelines. See which step was slow and where it failed, next to the screen and logs from that moment.
runs.apiTokenPlaceholder: Only needed when API_TOKEN is set
runs.authRequiredNotice: This server requires an API token. Fill in the field above first.
runs.notFound: That run is not here. It may have been pruned past the retention limit.
runs.timelineEmpty: No steps recorded. The run may not have started, or produced no report.
runs.deleteConfirm: This deletes the run record and its evidence. It cannot be undone.
